security_spec.violation_condition: When the FreeBSD kernel's RISC-V interrupt entry path (cpu_exception_handler_supervisor or bhyve guest interrupt injection) assumes that xithreshold is elevated to IPRIO (blocking all interrupts) during ISR execution, but the hardware or older spec implementation writes iprio[i] instead — the lower-priority threshold allows higher-iprio interrupts to nest into the handler, preempting critical sections that the kernel expected to run atomically with respect to interrupts.
security_spec.summary: Spec correction raising xithreshold to IPRIO (not iprio[i]) on interrupt entry; kernels compiled against the old wording may suffer unexpected interrupt nesting during ISR execution, breaking FreeBSD's assumption that interrupt handlers execute with all interrupts masked unless explicit threshold lowering is performed
